name: freeinference-companion
description: FreeInference observability for Codex: model health, session lifecycle metrics, and provider status. Context and cache metrics are not available from Codex and are reported as unknown. Community-built and unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FreeInference.

interface.shortDescription: FreeInference model health, session metrics, and provider status for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Community-built observability layer for FreeInference-powered Codex sessions. Surfaces live model health, session lifecycle metrics, and provider status without adding inference traffic or acting as a proxy. Context and cache metrics are Codex-unavailable and reported as unknown.
